validationEvidence: Integrated Widgetbook validation passed 29 checks, including all 911 examples at default knobs across five environments. This does not exercise every knob combination.

Representative source and implementation review found no further capability blocker. Reviewed sources included pricing, contact, press mentions, settings, dashboards and informational examples; this is not visual comparison of every reference instance.

Isolated iPad and iPhone simulator and Android emulator catalog checks and reviewed screenshots passed. iPad evidence includes paired-calendar range selection; iPhone and Android smoke checks cover the brand hero, a real tap and its callback receipt.

Native checks predate the final calendar weekday copy change to Mon through Sun. All 12 affected weekday-header goldens were subsequently independently reviewed: labels remain distinct, centered and unclipped in light and dark modes.

All local gates defined in scripts/ci/verify.sh passed after the weekday copy change, in segments resumed at unchanged remaining gates after formatter-only corrections. Independent source and representative visual review cleared reported findings. No physical-device, manual assistive-technology or production approval is claimed.
